title: claude-code-organizer — MCP Tool Poisoning Scanner + Accurate Token Budget
description: mcpware/claude-code-organizer (npx @mcpware/claude-code-organizer) provides two novel capabilities not in registry: (1) MCP tool poisoning security scanner — scans installed MCP server configs using the same content-signature algorithm as Claude Code to detect prompt injection attempts in tool descriptions; distinct from mcp-guard which focuses on vulnerability scanning (not prompt injection detection). (2) Accurate context token budget tracker — corrects autocompact buffer from displayed 33K to real 13K tokens, adds 20K warning threshold and 32K output reservation. Also includes: memory/config/hook management across scope hierarchy (user/project/local), scope migration, duplicate MCP server detection. Validation flag: accuracy claims sourced from March 31 2026 leaked Claude Code source — needs independent verification before integration.
relevance: HIGH for security angle — prompt injection detection via tool description analysis is novel vs existing mcp-guard entry. Context budget correction is independently verifiable.
validation_flag: CAUTION: Some accuracy claims derived from leaked source code (March 31 2026). Verify context budget numbers empirically before treating as authoritative.
